data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'rhēgē', meaning 'to flow' or 'to go'. Raye is often associated with the moon and its feminine, nurturing energy. The name Raye carries the meaning “Moon” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Raye usually hope their child will grow to embody moon and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Raye total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.
